# Badge

<p class="gls-text-lead">Easily create nice looking notification badges.</p>

## Usage

To create a badge, just add the `.gls-badge` class to an inline element like `<a>` or `<span>` element.

```html
<span class="gls-badge"></span>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<span class="gls-badge">1</span>
<span class="gls-badge">100</span>
</div>

```html
<span class="gls-badge">1</span> <span class="gls-badge">100</span>
```
